newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corporate debt activity seen sparse this week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corporate debt activity seen sparse this week.

text.p: Activity is expected to remain light in the corporate bond primary sector this week as some issuers opt for the sidelines amid higher financing rates and some players head out for industry conferences.
The recent volatility in the U.S. Treasury and stock markets has kept most players at bay. Dealers said a more stable rate environment is likely to lure some back in.

"There's a cautious tone in the market right now," said one syndicate source. "If we see the market stabilize we'll see a lot of activity but if it continues in a freefall, in an uncertain phase, then you're not going to see much get done."
